body: Embraer forecasts airlines in Asia Pacific will need about 1,050 small jets by 2045, rising to more than 2,500 when China is included, Raul Villaron, the manufacturer's senior vice president and head of Asia Pacific, told AeroTime during the 70th Assembly of Presidents of the Association of Asia Pacific Airlines (AAPA) in Kuala Lumpur. Around 295 small narrowbodies fly in the region today, and 16 airlines in six countries operate E-Jets. Globally, Embraer expects demand for about 8,500 jets of up to 150 seats over the next 20 years, with Asia Pacific accounting for roughly a third of future deliveries.

Villaron was candid about Embraer's slow start in the region, saying the company built its E-Jet business in the United States and Europe and was “lagging behind until about four years ago when we really started gaining traction.” That traction began with Scoot, followed by Virgin Australia and ANA in Japan. In October 2026, Japan Airlines ordered 16 E190-E2s, with options for 10 more, to replace the E170 and E190 fleet of its regional subsidiary J-AIR. According to Embraer's presentation at the Assembly, the E195-E2 now offers seat costs similar to larger narrowbodies with trip costs around 25% lower.

Shifting travel patterns are also opening the market. Since the pandemic, Villaron said, more people work from home and have moved to smaller cities, while companies build supply chains closer to home, stimulating flights into regional destinations. In Japan, where the population is shrinking and domestic demand is softening, airlines need smaller aircraft to keep serving regional cities; ANA, JAL and Fuji Dream Airlines now make Japan one of Embraer's strongest markets in the region. Over the past 12 months, full-service carriers in the region grew about 5%, while low-cost carriers declined by about 1.5%.

The Philippines offers a timely example. Under a government-mandated plan to decongest Manila's Ninoy Aquino International Airport (NAIA), carriers moved their remaining turboprop flights to Clark and other airports by March 29, 2026. Villaron said travelers heading to Siargao, Busuanga and El Nido now often face a two- to three-hour drive to Clark, and demand on those routes has dropped significantly. Embraer argues its jet can land at those destinations from Manila, restoring direct links without adding slow aircraft to a congested airport, although Villaron acknowledged that some airports may need longer runways first.

Embraer is expanding its support network as its customer base grows. It operates an E2 full-flight simulator in Singapore, along with E1 simulators in Japan, Australia and China, holds about $120 million worth of spare parts in Singapore, and has MRO partnerships with SIA Engineering in the Philippines and Fokker in Singapore. Villaron said Embraer customers achieve 99.8% schedule reliability. The company reported a record group backlog of $35.7 billion in the third quarter, has delivered more than 240 E2s to 27 operators, and holds orders for around 540 aircraft.
en.summary: Embraer forecasts Asia Pacific airlines will need about 1,050 small jets by 2045 — more than 2,500 including China — as its E2 family gains traction with low-cost carriers rethinking growth.
en.title: Embraer: Asia Pacific Will Need 2,500+ Small Jets by 2045

body: 在吉隆坡舉行的亞太航空公司協會第70屆總裁大會期間，巴航工業亞太區資深副總裁勞爾·維拉隆表示，亞太航空公司至2045年將需要約1050架小型機，若計入中國，數字將逾2500架。目前亞太地區僅約295架小型窄體機在飛，6個國家的16家航空公司營運E-Jet系列。全球來看，巴航工業預期未來20年對150座以下噴射機的需求約8500架，亞太約占未來交付量的三分之一。
維拉隆坦言，巴航工業過去在亞太發展落後，直到約4年前才真正站穩腳步，轉捩點始於酷航，隨後是維珍澳洲航空與全日空。2026年10月，日本航空訂購16架E190-E2、另有10架選擇權，用以汰換旗下區域子公司J-AIR的E170與E190機隊。根據巴航工業在會中的簡報，E195-E2的座位成本已與較大型窄體機相當，航程成本則低約25%。
經濟型態的轉變也推動需求。維拉隆指出，疫情後更多人居家工作並遷往較小城市，企業則把供應鏈移往鄰近國家，帶動區域航線需求；日本人口萎縮、內需趨緩，航空公司更需要小型機維持區域城市服務，全日空、日本航空與富士夢幻航空使日本成為巴航工業在亞太最強市場之一。過去12個月，區內全服務航空公司成長約5%，低成本航空則下滑約1.5%。
菲律賓是另一個例子。為紓解馬尼拉尼諾伊·艾奎諾國際機場壅塞，菲律賓政府要求航空公司於2026年3月29日前將剩餘螺旋槳航班移往克拉克等地，前往錫亞高、布蘇安加與愛妮島的旅客如今常需花2至3小時車程前往克拉克，需求明顯下滑。維拉隆表示，巴航工業的噴射機能從馬尼拉直飛這些目的地，恢復直航連結而不增加壅塞機場的慢速航班，但他也承認，部分機場可能須先延長跑道。
後勤支援也同步擴張：巴航工業在新加坡設有E2全動模擬機，日本、澳洲與中國設有E1模擬機，新加坡備件庫存約1.2億美元，並與菲律賓SIA Engineering及新加坡福克合作維修。維拉隆表示，客戶的班表可靠度達99.8%。巴航工業第3季未交付訂單達創紀錄的357億美元，E2至今已交付逾240架給27家營運商，訂單總數約540架。
zh.summary: 巴航工業預測，亞太航空公司至2045年將需要約1050架小型機，若計入中國則逾2500架；E2系列正協助低成本航空以更小機型開拓區域航線。
zh.title: 巴航工業預測亞太2045年前需要逾2500架小型機
